hpd_registrations.publisher: NYC Department of Housing Preservation and Development
hpd_registrations.limits: Registration records cover specified multiple dwellings and some one/two-family rentals, not all housing. Expired/historical registration and exact lot identity do not establish current occupancy; no rows is not no housing.

hpd_production.publisher: NYC Department of Housing Preservation and Development
hpd_production.limits: HPD affordable-production building/project records include program activity and dates, not all housing or proof of current occupancy/completion. A current BBL can differ from historical tax-lot identity.

dob_now.limits: DOB NOW filing rows are not completed projects or a complete pipeline. Exact-BBL lookup only; missing rows do not establish no activity.

dob_bis.limits: Legacy job/document rows, not unique projects or verified current use. Historical existing/proposed units are not current lawful dwellings. Exact-BBL queries miss unlinked filings and historical lot changes.
